intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: A coconut falls exactly as an elder mentions falling fruit. A bird calls when a child predicts a bird call. A fire goes out when a storyteller speaks of darkness. Some laugh; others are unsettled.

a1.text: Nothing Unusual: Everyone enjoys the coincidence and returns to work.

a2.text: The Skeptic's Embarrassment: A researcher dismisses the stories just as another extraordinary coincidence occurs.

a3.text: The Child's Explanation: A child discovers a loose branch, familiar bird calls, and a gust of wind. The mystery dissolves.

b1.text: The Hidden Prankster: Someone carefully arranged the occurrences.

b2.text: The Natural Explanation: Wind and animal behavior account for them.

b3.text: The Unanswered Mystery: All but one incident can be explained.

b4.text: The Unexpected Discovery: Investigators find an overlooked spring, cave opening, or useful plant.

c1.text: False Alarm: The villagers prepare for disaster; nothing happens.

c2.text: Lucky Warning: Precautions accidentally protect stored food from an unrelated heavy rain.

text_only.reason: narrative: stored food is protected, not changed

c3.text: The Great Panic: Rumors grow until someone insists Isola itself will vanish by sunset. It does not.

c4.text: The Prophecy Fulfilled: an actual strange phenomenon occurs. The researchers record it without claiming to understand it.
